concept: A steady mountain-star sanctuary expressing patient ascent through layered monumental stone.
floor: One continuous smooth blue-slate floor across the full top face, with broad pine-teal shading and no grass, snow, cracks, tiles, symbols, rings, or repeated pattern.
main_structure: One angular summit arch at the rear made from three large stepped slate masses and two abstract outward-curling cream crown forms around a warm summit beacon.
side_props: three large pine-teal crystal forms on the upper-left edge
one chunky cream rest bench and two slate blocks on the upper-right edge

perimeter.material: one continuous rounded slate wall with broad pine-teal and cream cap blocks

lighting: soft high-mountain morning light with one restrained warm summit glow
must_keep: exact canonical camera, canvas, footprint, stairs, tapered underside, and padding
entire bottom/front half as quiet open blue-slate floor
all additions inside the original silhouette
must_exclude: creature, goat, fish, animal, horns as an animal portrait, egg, or familiar baked into the bitmap
zodiac glyph, constellation, text, center circle, platform, plaza, ring, rug, path, or indentation
bridges, clouds, snow particles, watermark, external shadow, tiny rocks, cracks, or dense clutter
